title: Spa Filter Maintenance Weekly Days Since Clean Trend
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:filter days_since_clean=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_since_clean) as avg_duration, max(days_since_clean) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days since clean for spa filter maintenance events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_since_clean on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days since clean with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether spa filter maintenance tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
